title: EvaluationRun
description: Phase 3.2-B data contract. Identifies a single evaluation run: which task, dataset, and condition it covers, plus opaque references to the other five artifact types produced/consumed for that run. EvaluationRun NEVER embeds agent-visible content, evaluator-only content, execution output, or trace content directly -- it only carries identity fields and *_ref pointers, so that the agent-visible and evaluator-only planes can never be merged into one object by construction. Design choice (not fixed by the contract docs): all *_ref fields are opaque string identifiers, resolved by whichever physical storage/indexing mechanism a later Phase 3 stage defines (per TRACEABILITY_CONTRACT.md section 6, which explicitly leaves this open) -- this schema does not assume a filesystem path, database key, or URI scheme.

schema_version.description: Contract version for this object. Convention: '<phase-stage>.<revision>' (e.g. '3.2-b.1'), chosen for Phase 3.2-B and used consistently across all six evaluation contract schemas.

run_id.description: IMMUTABLE identity field. Uniquely identifies this evaluation run. Never reassigned or reused, mirroring the memory_id immutability rule in memory_schema.json.

task_id.description: IMMUTABLE identity field. Identifies the task (from the frozen Phase 2 dataset substrate) this run executed. Never changes for a given run_id.

dataset.description: Convenience/display dataset name, e.g. 'locomo', 'longmemeval', 'msc', 'conversation_chronicles'. Redundant with dataset_identity.dataset but kept as a separate top-level field per the 3.2-B task brief; dataset_identity is authoritative if the two ever disagree.

dataset_identity.description: IMMUTABLE identity field. Pins the exact frozen Phase 2 dataset/version this run's task was drawn from (per REPRODUCIBILITY_CONTRACT.md section 3: 'dataset version/hash, referencing the Phase 2 UMR / dataset manifest'). Never changes for a given run_id.

dataset.description: One of the four frozen Phase 3 datasets (see DATASET_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md).

dataset_version.description: Version/hash identifier of the frozen Phase 2 UMR/dataset manifest this task was drawn from.

condition.description: IMMUTABLE identity field. The controlled agent-level condition per EVALUATION_CONTRACT.md section 5: NO_MEMORY = Condition A (no-memory control), GOLD_EVIDENCE = Condition B (gold-evidence control), RETRIEVED_MEMORY = Condition C (the actual clean agent, retrieval+selection). Never changes for a given run_id -- a condition change is a different run.

configuration_identity.description: Free-form (additionalProperties allowed) pointer/record of the non-frozen configuration used for this run -- e.g. retrieval/reranking/selection parameters, reasoning model identity, prompt template version, decoding configuration (per CLEAN_AGENT_INTERFACES.md section 2.1 and REPRODUCIBILITY_CONTRACT.md section 3). Deliberately NOT tightly typed here: the exact configuration surface (top-K values, fusion formula, thresholds, prompt wording) is explicitly experimental/not-frozen per PHASE3_CLEAN_AGENT_FOUNDATION_SPEC.md section 4, so this schema only requires that *some* configuration identity be recorded, not any specific shape.

agent_visible_input_ref.description: Opaque reference to the AgentVisibleContext artifact used for this run. Points to a document that is structurally forbidden from containing evaluator-only fields -- see agent_visible_context.schema.json.

execution_result_ref.description: Opaque reference to the AgentExecutionResult artifact produced by this run.

trace_ref.description: Opaque reference to the TraceArtifact produced by this run.

evaluator_reference_ref.description: Opaque reference to the EvaluatorReference (gold answer, gold evidence IDs, etc.) for this run's task. This reference is consumed only by the evaluator/scoring path, never by agent execution -- see boundary.py.

evaluation_result_ref.description: Opaque reference to the EvaluationResult artifact produced by scoring this run. In 3.2-B this artifact is a placeholder (no metrics implemented yet) -- see evaluation_result.schema.json.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this EvaluationRun record was created.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last update to this record (e.g. when a *_ref was populated after a later pipeline stage completed). Optional: a freshly created run may not have been updated yet.
